title: Small Kitchen Organization: Four Picks for Cabinets and Pantries
description: Four organizers for small kitchens: an expandable spice shelf, under-shelf baskets, an airtight canister and an under-sink shelf. Sizes and what to measure first.
dek: Use the shelf height, the dead space and the cabinet under the sink.
hook: A small kitchen usually has the space it needs. It is just in the wrong shape. These four picks add levels to a cabinet, a shelf, a pantry and the space under the sink.
I did not test these. I read each listing and use only what it says, so check the details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is or what size it is.
Anything that needs tools, wiring or a permanent change, for the renter and small-space guides.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and its size or capacity.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: Start with the spot that annoys you most. If it is the pantry, the baskets and the canister come first. If it is the sink cabinet, start with the shelf.
hero_alt: A tidy pantry cabinet with clear canisters, a two-tier shelf and wire baskets hanging under a shelf
